name: Mitten Extracts Infused Preroll | Mango Zlurpee
description: Treat yourself to a burst of tropical flavor with Mango Zlurpee. Sweet, juicy mango takes center stage with candy-inspired notes that deliver a smooth, flavorful smoke from the first light to the last. Infused for an elevated experience and crafted to burn evenly, it's the perfect pre-roll for fans of bold fruit flavors.
